description: Score how easy an English text is to read: Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid Grade, Gunning Fog, SMOG, Coleman-Liau and Automated Readability Index (same formulas, sentence splitter and syllable estimate as the website), plus a verdict, average grade level, and Hemingway-style hints: long sentences (over 20 / 30 words), passive voice and adverbs. The formulas are built for English; for Arabic text the result says so (arabicWarning). Give "text" or a text file "path". Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/readability/

path.description: Or: a path to a UTF-8 text file.

name: text_readability
title: Readability score
